name: steward-skills-updates
title: workstation-steward in Claude Code: what needs updating?
desc: An illustrative Claude Code session, looping, in two scenes. Asked what needs updating, the supply-chain skill runs steward sc audit and steward sc plan without asking, since both are read-only, and sorts the results: gh is past the 3-day gate, Chrome should be updated now, a two-day-old python waits, a postgres major is the user's call, and a Docker container uses a floating tag. It offers three choices; after the user picks the upgrade, it shows the dry run, asks before upgrading, verifies every tool, and says how to roll back.

scenes.cmd: what needs updating on this Mac?

segs: Nothing alarming: no indicator of compromise matched. Here's what needs you:

scenes.out: Now        gh 2.103.1 → 2.103.2 is past the 3-day gate
Google Chrome 156 is out; browsers are never held, so update it from the app
Waiting    python@3.15 3.15.2 is 2 days old; it clears tomorrow
Your call  postgres 16 → 18 is a major, so it waits until you ask for it
Docker     ollama runs the floating :latest tag; pin it to a digest so it can't change under you
2. Show me the full plan first

segs: Done. gh 2.103.2 is installed and every tool passed verify. The old 2.103.1 stays on disk through

scenes.out: the 3-day soak, so `steward sc rollback` brings it back if anything breaks.
Chrome is yours: Chrome → About Google Chrome.
